content.title: Tesla, Palantir, Beyond Meat: Trending stocks
content.description:
One of Tesla's (TSLA) largest shareholders says it will vote against Elon Musk's trillion-dollar pay package. Palantir (PLTR) shares fall despite earnings beat, and AMD is down ahead of its financial results today. Following a rally yesterday, IREN and other infrastructure companies (CIFR, LUMN, AMKR) are deep in the red in pre-market. Beyond Meat (BYND) also nosedives after delaying reporting earnings.

For more live coverage of the markets, watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and visit Yahoo Finance.

content.title: Cipher Mining (CIFR): Losses Deepen 10.3% Annually, Revenue Forecast to Grow 33.8% Per Year
content.summary: Cipher Mining (CIFR) continues to operate at a loss, with annual losses deepening by 10.3% per year for the past five years. Looking ahead, the company is expected to remain unprofitable for at least three more years; however, revenue is forecast to accelerate at 33.8% per year, outpacing the US market average of 10.5%.
